summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 results and raised its 2026 full-year adjusted sales and adjusted operating profit outlook at CER, primarily due to increased GLP-1 product sales expectations. The filing includes financial figures, impairment charges, and conference call details. This is a routine earnings disclosure with an outlook revision, not a special-situation event. No transaction, activist activity, or structural corporate action is involved.
